scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix landing install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend/functions install
scripts.emulators: npm --prefix backend/functions run build && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions
scripts.build: npm --prefix landing run build && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend/functions run build
scripts.deploy:landing: npm --prefix landing run build && firebase deploy --only hosting:landing
scripts.deploy:panel: npm --prefix frontend run build && firebase deploy --only hosting:panel
